requirements.text: * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
* At least 4 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply)
* At least 2 years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud\-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies
* Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 7\+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C\#, Scala
* 3\+ years of experience with database and database management systems
* 3\+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or cloud\-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies
* 4\+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks
* 3\+ years of experience with front\-end JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks
* 4\+ years of experience creating synchronous and asynchronous APIs
* 3\+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks
* 3\+ years of experience using Git\-based version\-control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, Bitbucket)
* 3\+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments
* Experience leveraging modern AI\-based coding tools and IDE copilots
* Experience with interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion
* 1\+ year of experience mentoring engineers and driving professional development within technical teams
* 1\+ year of experience leveraging observability to identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in distributed systems
* Experience leading cross\-functional engineering efforts or large\-scale technical initiatives
* Experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams
